theorem line_budget {w : ℝ} {f : Config G n → ℂ} {C : ℝ} (hb : ∀ U, ‖f U‖ ≤ C)
    (hv : R.activities.KBound R.p w) :
    ∃ p : ℕ → ℝ, SumBudget (fun i => R.p.mass (X R i) (p i))
         (C * (R.p.mass Y 1 * (Real.exp (Y.card*w)-1))) ∧
      ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i ∧ ∀ U, ‖line R Y H q f i U‖ ≤ p i := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a,ha,hw⟩ := hv
  let s := stamp R Y H q
  let g (c : Cluster R Y) := C * ∏ i ∈ c.val,a i
  let p : ℕ → ℝ := extend s g (fun _ => 0)
  have hc : 0 ≤ C := (norm_nonneg _).trans (hb 1)
  have he (c) : p (s c) = g c := s.injective.extend_apply ..
  have hz (i : ℕ) (hi : i∉range s) : p i = 0 := extend_apply' _ _ _ hi
  have hh (i) : 0 ≤ p i ∧ ∀ U, ‖line R Y H q f i U‖ ≤ p i := by
    by_cases ht : i ∈ range s
    · obtain ⟨c,rfl⟩ := ht
      have hy : 0 ≤ g c := mul_nonneg hc (Finset.prod_nonneg fun j _ => (ha j).1)
      refine ⟨(he c).symm ▸ hy,fun U => ?_⟩
      rw [he,show line R Y H q f (s c) = _ from line_stamp ..]
      unfold chunk
      split
      · rw [norm_mul,norm_prod]
        exact mul_le_mul (hb U) (Finset.prod_le_prod (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _) fun i _ =>
          (Complex.norm_real _).trans_le ((ha i).2 U)) (Finset.prod_nonneg fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _) hc
      rw [norm_zero]; exact hy
    simp [hz _ ht, line_empty _ _ _ _ _ ht]
  refine ⟨p,?_,hh⟩
  let k := fun i => R.p.mass (X R i) (p i)
  have ht : SumBudget (k ∘ s) (C * (R.p.mass Y 1 * (Real.exp (Y.card*w)-1))) := by
    have ht := budget_scale (budget_cluster R Y (fun i => (ha i).1) hw) hc
    have hx (c : Cluster R Y) : (k ∘ s) c = C * R.p.mass (span R Y c) (∏ i∈c.val, a i) := by
      unfold comp k
      rw [he,show X R (s c)=_ from stamp_x ..]; exact mass_scale ..
    exact (funext hx).symm ▸ ht
  have hj i (hi : i∉range s) : k i=0 := by simp [k,BudgetPoint.mass,hz i hi]
  refine ⟨fun i => mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (hh i).1,(s.injective.summable_iff hj).mp ht.2.1,?_⟩
  have hg : Function.support k ⊆ range s := by
    intro i hi
    by_contra he
    exact hi (hj _ he)
  exact (s.injective.tsum_eq hg).symm.trans_le ht.2.2

proof_context.conclusion: The forced coefficients attached to the clusters are majorized by `p i` with total mass at most `C * (mass Y 1 * (exp (card Y * w) - 1))`, via `budget_cluster` over nonempty clusters.

lemma supplement_bound (h : S.Sound A) {B : ℝ} (hb : 1 ≤ B)
    (ht : ∀ (i : F.Index) U, ‖S.places (Size.axis F i) o U‖ ≤ B) (v : F.Coeff) (U) :
    ‖supplement S R o v U‖ ≤ fullCost F R.p B * F.coeffSize (F.core v) := by
  have hB := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hb
  let z := F.scaled R.p.threshold⁻¹ (F.core v)
  have h0 := R.p.threshold_pos
  have hQ : 0 ≤ fullCost F R.p B := by unfold fullCost; positivity
  by_cases hh : Healthy R.p.threshold (S.footprint o) U
  · rw [healthy_supplement S R o h v _ hh,norm_zero]
    exact mul_nonneg hQ (Work.G08.size_nonneg ..)
  have ht' : supplement S R o v U = S.places z o U := by
    simp only [supplement,part,LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk,masked_ne _ _ _ _ hh]
    nth_rw 1 [← Size.core_plus F v]
    simp only [map_add,map_smul,SectionData.places,S.eval_linear.map_add, Frame.scaled_unit,
      S.eval_linear.map_smul,Pi.add_apply,h.unit,Pi.one_apply,Pi.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul]; unfold z; ring
  rw [ht']
  let f : F.Coeff →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ := {
    toFun i := S.places i o U
    map_add' a b := congr_fun (S.eval_linear.map_add a b) (expandAt o U)
    map_smul' a b := congr_fun (S.eval_linear.map_smul a b) (expandAt o U) }
  have hz i : ‖z i‖ ≤ R.p.threshold⁻¹^(degree F) * ‖F.core v i‖ := by
    have hh : 1 ≤ R.p.threshold⁻¹ := (one_le_inv₀ h0).mpr R.p.threshold_le
    have he : (F.grades i).2 ≤ degree F := Finset.le_sup (f:=fun i => (F.grades i).2) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    unfold z
    rw [F.scaled_apply,norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_right₀ hh he) (norm_nonneg _)
  calc
    _ = ‖∑ i, z i • f (Size.axis F i)‖ := by simp_rw [← map_smul,← map_sum,Size.sum_axes]; rfl
    _ ≤ ∑ i, ‖z i • f (Size.axis F i)‖ := norm_sum_le ..
    _ ≤ ∑ i, fullCost F R.p B * ‖F.core v i‖ := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => by
      rw [norm_smul]; refine (mul_le_mul (hz i) (ht i U) (norm_nonneg _)
        ((norm_nonneg _).trans (hz i))).trans_eq ?_; unfold fullCost; ring
    _ = _ := by rw [Frame.coeffSize,Finset.mul_sum]

proof_context.conclusion: `supplement` is bounded by `fullCost F p B * coeffSize (core v)`, the analogue of |f_v| <= C_d t^{-d} |v|_1.
